source: CORP-18 Combined sector + macro stress, Delta, engine output (no model call)

selected.label: 504 facilities across 200 borrowers at 2026Q2, only the facilities that matched. Membership is fixed as at this period

components.label: Opening ECL
components.definition: Booked (reported) ECL of the scope before the movement.

components.label: New originations
components.definition: ECL of exposures that entered the book between the periods.
components.reason: A scenario revalues the frozen book at one period; movements BETWEEN periods (originations, repayments, cures, defaults, recoveries) are not part of it.

components.label: Repayment / amortisation
components.definition: ECL released as exposure was repaid or amortised.
components.reason: A scenario revalues the frozen book at one period; movements BETWEEN periods (originations, repayments, cures, defaults, recoveries) are not part of it.

components.label: Stage 1 → 2
components.definition: Change from exposures migrating Stage 1 to Stage 2 (SICR).
components.reason: Stages are held at their reported values (stage policy 'frozen'), so no exposure migrates.

components.label: Stage 2 → 3
components.definition: Change from exposures migrating Stage 2 to Stage 3.
components.reason: Stages are held at their reported values (stage policy 'frozen'), so no exposure migrates.

components.label: Cures
components.definition: ECL released by exposures curing to a better stage.
components.reason: A scenario revalues the frozen book at one period; movements BETWEEN periods (originations, repayments, cures, defaults, recoveries) are not part of it.

components.label: New defaults
components.definition: Change from exposures newly defaulting.
components.reason: A scenario revalues the frozen book at one period; movements BETWEEN periods (originations, repayments, cures, defaults, recoveries) are not part of it.

components.label: PD
components.definition: Effect of the probability-of-default moves.

components.label: LGD
components.definition: Effect of the loss-given-default moves.

components.label: CCF / EAD / utilisation
components.definition: Effect of exposure moves: CCF, drawn balance, utilisation, EAD.
components.reason: No rule of this kind in this scenario.

components.label: Collateral
components.definition: Effect of collateral value moves, via their governed LGD translation.
components.reason: No collateral rule in this scenario.

components.label: Rating / score migration
components.definition: Effect of rating-notch or score-band moves via the governed masterscale / scorecards.
components.reason: No rule of this kind in this scenario.

components.label: Macro (MEV)
components.definition: Effect of macroeconomic moves via the governed sensitivity library.

components.label: Sector / segment rule
components.definition: Effect of a rule whose driver is a sector or segment selection rather than a parameter.
components.reason: No rule of this kind in this scenario.

components.label: Management overlay / user-defined
components.definition: The reader's own stated impact (Method 3) or a management overlay.
components.reason: No rule of this kind in this scenario.

components.label: Recoveries / write-offs
components.definition: ECL released through recoveries and write-offs.
components.reason: A scenario revalues the frozen book at one period; movements BETWEEN periods (originations, repayments, cures, defaults, recoveries) are not part of it.

components.label: Method effect (not attributable)
components.definition: A method's total scenario effect that the method cannot split by driver (the ML emulator predicts the whole move).
components.reason: Every movement is attributed to a driver.

components.label: Calibration gap
components.definition: Difference between a method's own baseline and booked ECL; never hidden inside scenario effects (§11).
components.reason: This method starts from the booked baseline, so there is no calibration gap.

components.label: Interaction / residual
components.definition: What the driver bars do not explain. Shown, never spread.

components.label: Closing ECL
components.definition: ECL of the scope after the movement.

cross_scope.identity: selected delta + rest-of-book delta = total delta
cross_scope.rest_of_book_reason: The scenario is applied to the selected scope only; every exposure outside it keeps its booked ECL exactly, so the rest of the book contributes zero. No portfolio-wide stage, macro or overlay logic moves it.
